query:
SELECT name, urgencyScore, briefGeneratedAt, 
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(briefData, '$.rawGrokUrgency')) as rawGrokUrgency,
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(briefData, '$.rawGrokIntelligence')) as rawGrokIntelligence
FROM companies 
WHERE name LIKE '%Key Technology%' AND briefData IS NOT NULL 
LIMIT 3;
